title: Naukri Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, places, remote or office, experience, pay, key skills, company rating, posting dates and job link, and with details on the description, job type, department, role, industry, education and applicants. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: jobs Naukri listed, jobs matched and saved, checked links, notes about how the input was read, the settings used and the calls made.
